entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It is hard for me to even[n]fathom what it could be.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: People have really been up in arms[n]about the whole cleanse thing...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: To think a global hacker group[n]would be targeting us...
entries.uk: Подумати лишень, світова[n]хакерська група взялася за нас...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah, I guess it'd be easy if[n]that was one of our options...
entries.uk: Ага, було б легко, якби[n]в нас був такий варіант...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: No matter how you look at it,[n]we need a countermeasure.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Our best bet would be Alibaba...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But she may not be capable[n]of it in her current state.
entries.uk: Але в її теперішньому стані[n]вона може не впоратися.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I guess we should think of[n]some other ways too then.
entries.uk: Тоді, мабуть, варто подумати[n]й про інші способи.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Yes, it would be best to have[n]as many solutions as possible.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Well we still got time, so let's[n]come up with something good, k?
entries.uk: Ну, час ще є, тож вигадаймо[n]щось гарне, ок?
